description: lib/string.fz next_grapheme_size (:688) is codepoint_size(first_byte(s)), so next_grapheme/1 (:703), graphemes/1 (:720) and length/1 (:108, codepoint_count) count codepoints. Elixir's are Unicode extended grapheme clusters: "e\u0301" is one grapheme, an emoji ZWJ sequence is one. String.slice/pad (fz-sc8.14) are built on these.
title: String graphemes are extended grapheme clusters, as in Elixir
